mpm.title: Managing Public Money
mpm.scope: In broad terms it applies to UK central government bodies, as well as other specified public sector bodies. The devolved administrations have equivalent rulebooks.

govs.title: Government Functional Standards (GovS 001 to GovS 015)
govs.scope: These standards are mandated for use across central government, and may also be adopted by other public sector organisations.

board-code.title: Code of Conduct for Board Members of Public Bodies
board-code.scope: Standards expected from those on boards of government departments, non-ministerial departments, executive agencies, NDPBs, and national public corporations.

cs-code.title: Civil Service Code
cs-code.scope: The Civil Service code outlines the Civil Service's core values, and the standards of behaviour expected of all civil servants.

lg-transparency.title: Local Government Transparency Code 2015
lg-transparency.scope: Sets out the minimum data that local authorities should be publishing, the frequency it should be published and how it should be published.

spfm.title: Scottish Public Finance Manual
spfm.scope: Issued by the Scottish Ministers, it sets out the main principles for dealing with resources in public sector organisations in Scotland; bodies sponsored by the Scottish Government include executive NDPBs, public corporations and NHS bodies.

mwpm.title: Managing Welsh Public Money
mwpm.scope: The framework applies to the Welsh Government, its sponsored bodies, the NHS in Wales, its commissioners, the Education Workforce Council, Estyn and the Welsh Government's subsidiary bodies.

mpmni.title: Managing Public Money Northern Ireland
mpmni.scope: It sets out the main principles for dealing with resources used by public sector organisations in Northern Ireland.

procurement-act.title: Procurement Act 2023
procurement-act.scope: A contracting authority is a public authority (or, for utilities contracts, also a public undertaking or private utility) other than an excluded authority; devolved Scottish authorities are excluded (section 2).

foi-depts.title: Freedom of Information Act 2000 (government departments)
foi-depts.scope: Schedule 1, Part I, paragraph 1: any government department, with named exceptions.

foi-lg.title: Freedom of Information Act 2000 (local government)
foi-lg.scope: Schedule 1, Part II: local authorities in England and Wales within the meaning of the Local Government Act 1972, and district councils in Northern Ireland.

foi-nhs.title: Freedom of Information Act 2000 (the NHS)
foi-nhs.scope: Schedule 1, Part III: bodies of the National Health Service.

psed.title: Equality Act 2010, public sector equality duty (section 149)
psed.scope: Schedule 19, Part 1 lists the authorities: a Minister of the Crown and government departments; a county, district or parish council in England; NHS bodies in England.

companies-act.title: Companies Act 2006
companies-act.scope: Applies to companies registered under it; the body has a Companies House number.

charities-act.title: Charities Act 2011
charities-act.scope: Applies to charities in England and Wales; the body has a Charity Commission registration number.

foisa-ministers.title: Freedom of Information (Scotland) Act 2002 (the Scottish Ministers)
foisa-ministers.scope: Schedule 1, Part 1, paragraph 1: the Scottish Ministers.

foisa-councils.title: Freedom of Information (Scotland) Act 2002 (local government)
foisa-councils.scope: Schedule 1, Part 3, paragraph 21: a council constituted by section 2 of the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994.

foisa-nhs.title: Freedom of Information (Scotland) Act 2002 (the NHS in Scotland)
foisa-nhs.scope: Schedule 1, Part 4 (The National Health Service): Health Boards, the Common Services Agency, Healthcare Improvement Scotland, the National Waiting Times Centre Board, NHS 24, Public Health Scotland, the Scottish Ambulance Service Board and others.

public-appointments.title: Governance Code on Public Appointments
public-appointments.scope: Applies to all public appointments made to bodies listed in the Public Appointments Order in Council; this body is on the list GOV.UK publishes (May 2026), matched by exact name.
